title: Demo Vaults
tagline: Read-only demo vaults, published as encrypted archives. Every entry lists its read key — that is the point: read access is a capability you can hand out. Write keys are never published, anywhere.
site_note: Base for archive downloads. Switch to https://demos.sgit.ai once that DNS resolves (CNAME demos -> sgit-ai.github.io); until then that host is NXDOMAIN and every download link 404s.

entries.title: Demo Vaults (this catalogue)
entries.one_line: The vault you are reading right now: the catalogue app, its data, and every published demo vault archive — a vault listing vaults, including itself.

entries.title: RiskMandate — the Black Hat register
entries.one_line: A risk register built live with visitors at a Black Hat stand: a vault app with an LLM chat, a fact-risk graph explorer, a kanban board rendered from markdown issues, and a two-session agent channel where the Claude inside the vault briefs the Claude building it.

links.label: Role risk map — the risk org chart (5 Aug)
links.summary: Risks flow upward through the reporting structure to an accountable owner, arriving either by direct assignment or via the risk chain. No risk ends up orphaned, and once one lands on a named person they can challenge whether it belongs there.

links.label: All three MVP walkthroughs, summarised
links.summary: Graph browser, risk chains and role risk map as one pipeline: questions become facts, facts become risks that connect upward to the corporate register, and each risk lands on a named owner. Includes the project lead rejecting a risk the tool generated, and why that argument is the point.

entries.title: Deploy SG/Send
entries.one_line: The living deployment-documentation vault behind the deploy section of sgit.ai: seven deployment targets, two AWS runbooks, a scripts index and three reference pages.

entries.title: Field Notes
entries.one_line: The vault-app-embed demo from sgit.ai: six small studies, each a note and a drawing, served as a vault app with a deliberately published read key.
